findings.original: Any two of the factors may vary and the third remain constant
findings.rewrite: Any two of the factors (the length of the working day, the productivity of labor, and the intensity of labor) may vary
findings.problem: The list of factors was added only to satisfy a checker bug (now fixed) and is not in the original paragraph.
findings.fix: Any two of the factors may vary while the third stays constant

findings.original: the diminution in the productiveness of agricultural labour
findings.rewrite: the fall in the productivity of labor in agriculture
findings.problem: The wording was bent for the same checker bug; the closer rendering of "agricultural labour" is now possible.
findings.fix: the fall in the productivity of agricultural labor

findings.original: finds at last a limit in the generalisation of labour
findings.rewrite: finds a limit in the generalization of labor, that is, in labor becoming general to all
findings.problem: The added "that is" clause is an interpretation of Marx's phrase, not a §1.1 permitted addition.
findings.fix: In this direction, the shortening of the working day finally finds a limit in the generalization of labor.

notes_review: The logged calls are sound, except note 1 (the p029 addition), which existed only for the checker and is now removed, and note 9's gloss on "generalization of labor", which adds an interpretation. Keeping the ambiguous "it" in p014 and the lower-case "s/c" in p015 as printed is correct.
summary: Fidelity is high: all three sets of laws, every number and the Malthus and MacCulloch notes are intact, with Marx's irony kept. Readability is good, and the only problems are two small additions and one checker-driven wording.
